string_values: Partial northern PNG reach142-146E downstream of Vitiaz. Exclude Vitiaz Strait,upstream Solomon Sea branches,surface NGCC identity,New Britain and equatorial retroflection/EUC. Fixed290degree northwest component is an editorial approximation based on local142E alongshore orientation,not an along-route rotated axis. A connected same-sign surface layer can merge NGCC and NGCUC;this diagnostic does not classify water masses or establish branch separation.
Inclusive component-thickness lower support under original contiguous piecewise-linear model definition; single-level zero is an uninformative bound, not absence.

Partial east New Ireland regional reach4.4-2.6S. Exclude cross-basin Solomon Strait,NBCU/St Georges branches,northern Bismarck/EUC split and full current endpoints. Historical WEPOCS observed235m alongshore core cited by Melet2010 is regional core evidence,not a physical bottom or a2022observation. Fixed northward component does not reproduce a locally rotated alongshore axis.

Short partial eastern Bougainville/Solomon Islands model-proposal context6.6-6S around the published6S model section. Do not infer continuous current along the full Solomon island chain,connection to NICU or observational confirmation. Melet2010 proposed SICU with modeled~200m core;later local cruise context is distinct. Fixed northward diagnostic does not reproduce source density mask or prove named-current identity.

temporal_scope: Four exact March/June/September/December15,2022snapshots,not seasonal means/annual extrema/historical observations/model climatology.
method: Finite paired component contours and unique linear transverse strips under each original fixed axis;minimum native-supported span where boundaries are censored. All three batches queried under one cumulative ledger.
window_interpretation: NGCUC100–300m and NICU/SICU100–350m select original cores;they do not impose upper/lower boundaries,force detached subsurface flow or establish physical thickness. No surface gate added.
layer_metric_interpretation: Thickness is lower minus upper depth,not absolute lower depth,core depth,search limit,sampled limit or bed.
minimum_span_interpretation: Conditional first-to-last contiguous native support under original piecewise-linear signed-component model,not physical current thickness bounds. Single-level zero is uninformative,not absence.
range_interpretation: Native-bracket sampling scenarios,not physical uncertainty,confidence intervals or annual envelopes.
identity_scope: NGCUC partial northern PNG142–146E is not surface NGCC,Vitiaz passage or upstream branches/retroflection/EUC. NICU regional east New Ireland historical observed-core context remains distinct from model-proposed SICU short eastern Bougainville reach. No observational confirmation or historical core evidence transferred to SICU,no full island-chain continuity or independently identified physical body. Absent NGCUC evidence-basis field remains null,not borrowed from another source.
axis_anchor_interpretation: 40original model axis proxies and8explicit null gaps with original candidate diagnoses;no replacement core,date,branch,gate or source. Each pointer is scoped by its exact source_compiled_descriptor_file and hash.
interpretation: Partial regional component geometry,not independently identified named-current axis,flow-normal width,whole-route depth,terrain clearance or physical volume. No between-section interpolation or additive water bodies.
source_credit: HYCOM Consortium,NRL,COAPS-FSU;original fields and qualifiers retained.
